review:
Ancient Egypt on paylines, built around Wild Scarab Multipliers – each one applies a multiplier of up to 999x to every line win it's part of. That's where the big results come from.

Sandstorms nudge every scarab on the grid into new spots, creating fresh lines. Three FS trigger the bonus. Rated 3/5, 10,000x max, RTP versions from 96.27% down to 86.19%. Great if you prefer multiplier wilds to cluster cascades.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.19% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
